name: verso-ui
description: The window's HTML/TypeScript (Phase 2, walking skeleton). Talks to the core only through the generated bindings.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/main.js --sourcemap && esbuild src/harness.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/harness.js --sourcemap && cp index.html style.css harness.html dist/ && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/ && rm -rf dist/cmaps dist/standard_fonts && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps dist/cmaps && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts dist/standard_fonts && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/web/pdf_viewer.css dist/ && rm -rf dist/images && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/web/images dist/images && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css dist/ && rm -rf dist/fonts/katex && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp -R node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/. dist/fonts/
